text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф's vice-president and
right hand,
Эйр Грув, worries for her
wellbeing since she
insists on balancing
her student council duties
with a
grueling training schedule.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The other vice-president, Нарита Брайан,
comes off
as blunt at first, but she
clearly cares for the
student council's
new general manager.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф seems delighted to have
people
looking up to her. Over the
course of the day, I
catch a glimpse of
her relationships with the other
student
council members.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
